_about: Dan's calls. Each sentence entry repeats the French it was made on, so a decision goes stale if the workbook text changes. Sentence actions: confirm (accept the Tatoeba match; english_source tamago_original when Tatoeba links no translation), replace (use tatoeba_id, optional english), keep (status dan_reviewed, source tamago_original, needs a native-speaker check before Phase 4). Answers: {A0003: {action: keep, answer: text}}. Units: {U01: {action: approve}} is Dan's go-live; only he adds it. Phase 2a: units approves a pulled unit; cut_sentences drops pulled sentences; vocabulary_additions adds words to a unit; hints overrides a built hint; borrow lets a unit's lessons use earlier units' sentences.
